name: Pillar Sky City — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Unequal sandstone/rock pillars with inhabited garden tops, small open arcade buildings and roofed pavilions, narrow suspended rope bridges and waterfalls down faces. Detailed study is a pillar settlement rather than the map's pink palace-like shorthand. Hidden layout inference: Provide one lower arrival shelf and an accessible ascent to two principal inhabited tops; bridge paths branch to smaller lookout gardens and return through a loop. Keep near/far bridges at distinct levels and preserve open vistas beneath colonnades; use existing travel anchors where physical access is unresolved. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B14-STRUCT-001 — Pillar Sky City — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need rock-to-platform footings, open arcade/corner hosts, platform edge/rail segments, rope-bridge anchor/deck details and stair-ascent joins. Do not repurpose porcelain bridge deck as rope bridge. Hanging vines and sparse canopy pockets; roosting birds/butterflies proposed. Elevation/access/collision unresolved. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.

B14-STRUCT-001-S01 — Rock pillar/platform seat. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 6, 12]m proposed. One isolated rock pillar/platform seat matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
